rows.name: animal_totals
rows.value: @calc(Object.values(@data.alimentation_animaux_categorie || {}).filter(a => Object.values(@data.alimentation_animaux || {}).some(f => String(f.id) === String(a.animal_feed_id) && String(f.upa_code) === String(@fields.upa_code) && String(f.year) === String(@local.annee_choisie))).reduce((acc, a) => { acc[a.categorie] = (acc[a.categorie] || 0) + Number(a.nb_animaux || 0); return acc; }, {}))
